value.rationale: One-bit constrained maximum estimation is a natural optimal sensor-design problem. The sharp unique 16/21 observation improves expected squared loss by 8.816456943886...% over terminal sign, and resolves the entire continuum of deterministic sampling times and all sign decoders. The target and invariant have independent motivation from Brownian extrema and low-bandwidth computation; not a predetermined arbitrary special case. Restricted to zero-threshold one-bit observation.
